parameters.text:
You are acting as the Assistant Vice President (VP) – Commercial and Senior FIDIC Contracts Specialist representing the Employer / Developer. 

Analyze both attached documents simultaneously:
- attachment_0: The incoming Contractor's Variation Order (VO) claim, letter, and backup measurements.
- attachment_1: The signed Contract Agreement / Baseline conditions.

Cross-reference the variation claim against the contract terms to perform a strict commercial audit. Evaluate:
1. Contractual Entitlement (under relevant contract clauses).
2. Scope Verification and technical justification.
3. Cost substantiation and rate adjustments against baseline rates.

Provide a clear commercial recommendation, the audited net VO amount, and justification notes.

// 1. Pull dynamic values submitted from the AVP Form and Financial Engine const form = $('Wait for Commercial Approval').first().json; const fin = $('Calculate VO Financials').first().json; const baseline = $('Format Variation Input').first().json; // 2. Map Project & Contract Details const projectName = fin.project_name || baseline.project_name || 'Sample Waterfront Development, Main Works Package'; const contractorName = fin.contractor_name || baseline.contractor_name || 'Example Contracting LLC'; const contractRef = baseline.contract_ref || fin.contract_ref || 'EXD/CON/SAMPLE/001'; const contractType = fin.contract_type || baseline.contract_type || 'LUMPSUM'; const scopeSummary = baseline.scope_summary || 'INFRASTRUCTURE SCOPE VARIATION OF THE INFRASTRUCTURE WORKS PACKAGE'; // 3. Map Financial Figures const approvedBudget = fin.display?.approved_budget || 'AED 50,150,000.00'; const committedAmount = fin.display?.committed_amount || 'AED 2,150,000.00'; const balanceBudget = fin.display?.balance_budget || 'AED 48,000,000.00'; const balanceBudgetPostVo = fin.display?.balance_budget_post_vo || 'AED 48,365,000.00'; const originalContractPrice = fin.display?.original_contract_sum || 'AED 3,260,000.00'; const previousVariations = fin.display?.previous_variations || 'AED 285,000.00'; const thisVoAmount = fin.display?.this_vo_amount || '(AED 365,000.00)'; const revisedContractPrice = fin.display?.revised_contract_sum || 'AED 3,120,000.00'; // 4. Map Dynamic Form Narrative Inputs const reasonNarrative = form.reason_narrative || 'hod approval'; const consultantConfirmation = form.consultant_pm_confirmation || `Confirmed by Employer's PM based on Engineer Recommendation (${baseline.letter_ref || 'EXC-VX-0001'})`; const procurementVerification = form.procurement_verification || 'Agreed in Principle'; const sapCode = form.sap_code || 'RAH21/01-CC-INFRA'; const commercialRecommendation = form.commercial_recommendation || 'Recommended for Approval'; const timeImpact = fin.time_impact || baseline.time_impact || 'No Time Impact'; const commercialJustification = form.commercial_justification || `With reference to Clause-I of Contract & Schedule (D) (${contractRef})`; const todayFormatted = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); // 5. Generate 2-Page HTML Matching Company Standard const htmlContent = `
Project - ${projectName}
CONTRACTOR - ${contractorName} | CONTRACT TYPE: ${contractType}
SCOPE: ${scopeSummary}
BUDGET DETAILS CONTRACT DETAILS
APPROVED BUDGET VALUE${approvedBudget} LOA/CONTRACT PRICE${originalContractPrice}
COMMITTED AMOUNT${committedAmount} APPROVED VARIATION${previousVariations}
BALANCE BUDGET${balanceBudget} VALUE OF THIS VARIATION${thisVoAmount}
BALANCE BUDGET POST VO${balanceBudgetPostVo} REVISED CONTRACT PRICE${revisedContractPrice}
SUBSTANTIATION FOR THIS VARIATION - NARRATIVE
AReference:${commercialJustification}
BReason for this Variation:${reasonNarrative}
CVariation confirmation by Consultant/PM:${consultantConfirmation}
DCost & Time Implications:Cost Impact: ${thisVoAmount} | Time Impact: ${timeImpact}
ECost Verification by Procurement:${procurementVerification}
FPossible Cost Recovery:Not Applicable
GRequest for Budget Reallocation in SAP:${sapCode} = ${thisVoAmount}
HCommercial Recommendation:${commercialRecommendation}
JRevised Contract Price Upon VO Approval:${revisedContractPrice}
Organized by
Md. Zakiuddin Ahmed
AVP - Commercial
✓ Submitted & Verified
 Reviewed by
Ahmed Abuarada
Sr. Project Manager
 Reviewed by
Ashish Gupta
VP Procurement
Approved by
Bachar Jamil
AVP Design & Projects
 Endorsed by
Raman Garg
Group CFO
 Approved by
Benoy Kurien
Group CEO
VARIATION ORDER (VO) EXAMPLE DEVELOPER
PROJECT:${projectName}
CONTRACTOR:${contractorName}
LOA/CONTRACT REF:${contractRef}
VO SUBJECT:VARIATION ORDER - ${scopeSummary}
VO No:VO#2/SWD/EXD/2026
RFA No:2024/PRJ/0001
VO DATE:${todayFormatted}
SECTION ONE: Description of Variation
Under the terms of the above Contract, we issue the following variation to your contract agreement:
As recommended by the Engineer and approved by Management, the scope of works shall be adjusted as detailed below:
Scope DescriptionAmount (AED)
1) Additional scope of works as detailed below (A)AED 0.00
2) Value of Omitted / Adjusted Scope of Work as per Engineer recommendation upon completion (B)${thisVoAmount}
SECTION TWO: Cost Impact
DescriptionTotals (AED)
Contract Sum${originalContractPrice}
Effect of previous variations (+/-)${previousVariations}
Sub-Total${committedAmount}
Effect of this Variation${thisVoAmount}
Revised Contract Sum${revisedContractPrice}
Terms & Conditions: No Changes to the terms included in the contract. | Completion of works: TBA
AUTHORISATION SECTION
For Contractor: ${contractorName}
Name: Authorized Representative
Designation: Project Director / Managing Director
[Signed & Sealed]
 For Employer: Example Developer LLC
Name: Benoy Kurien
Designation: Group CEO
[Pending Executive Sign-Off]
`; return [{ json: { html: htmlContent, fileName: `${contractRef.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_')}_VO_Draft.pdf`, letter_ref: contractRef, project_name: projectName, this_vo_amount: thisVoAmount, revised_contract_sum: revisedContractPrice } }];
